const TAU=Math.PI*2,clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v)),mix=(a,b,k)=>a+(b-a)*k;
function sin(t){return Math.sin(t)}
function rr(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r)}
function text(ctx,str,x,y,size,color,weight='600',align='left'){
 ctx.font=`${weight} ${size}px system-ui, Arial, sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign=align;ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillText(str,x,y);

function hexAlpha(hex,a){let h=hex.replace('#','');return `rgba(${parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16)},${parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16)},${parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16)},${a})`}
function line(ctx,x1,y1,x2,y2,col,width=2,opacity=1){ctx.globalAlpha=opacity;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.stroke();ctx.globalAlpha=1;}
function dot(ctx,x,y,r,col,alpha=1){ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU);ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fill();ctx.globalAlpha=1}
function ring(ctx,x,y,r,col,width=3,alpha=1){ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,Math.max(.5,r),0,TAU);ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.stroke();ctx.globalAlpha=1}
function arc(ctx,cx,cy,rx,ry,t,col,w=2,angle=0){ctx.save();ctx.translate(cx,cy);ctx.rotate(angle);ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,rx,ry,0,t,t+Math.PI*1.55);ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
